# {{$site.title}}

> {{$site.description}}

{{$site.title}} is an open-source, community-built encyclopedia. Anyone can add or
edit a page by opening a Pull Request on GitHub ({{$site.github}}). Content is
static HTML generated with SiteGen. Pages are organized into categories: companies,
people, apps, games, websites, and interactive tools.
